user.title: Connect to UniFi Network
user.description: Use a local UniFi OS account (not Ubiquiti SSO) without MFA. Pro AV must be enabled in the Network application.

data_description.host: IP or hostname of the console. A scheme and port may be included, e.g. http://localhost:8443 for the mock server.
data_description.unifi_os: On for UDM/UCG/Cloud Key Gen2 consoles (/proxy/network). Off for a legacy standalone controller.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave off for the console's self-signed certificate.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with UniFi
reauth_confirm.description: The console at {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter them again.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the console. Check the address and network.
error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. Use a local account without MFA.
error.no_proav: Connected, but the Pro AV endpoints were not found. Enable Pro AV in UniFi Network 10.3 or newer, or check the site name.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the matrix is read (5-300 seconds). Default 15.

unknown_source.message: Unknown source "{source}". Pick a transmitter from the source list.

not_routed.message: Receiver {name} has no source routed. Select a source first.
